source: Castilla-La Mancha, Ciencias Generales, EvAU convocatoria ordinaria, curso 2023/2024, Bloque 4 Las fuerzas que nos mueven, cuestión 1
format_adaptations: Textualized the velocity-time graph using the values from the official solution and removed the qualitative question about the type of motion in each segment; no numeric data or physics changed.
verification_note: Solved only with linear kinematics: a = Δv/Δt in each segment. Δv (subtraction of velocities) divided by Δt (subtraction of times) propagates to AccelerationQuantity via prop_sub + prop_acc.
